verdict.rationale: Aleph's financial-reporting page lists "audit logs" among its enterprise security features, so it has its own change-logging capability. That is only a single marketing mention, with no detail on whether it records who changed what and when on the model. "Versioned forecasts" is the only hint of versioning, and nothing documents rolling back a model change. Missing for 10: documented audit-trail detail (user, change, timestamp), explicit rollback/restore of model changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
